info.name: Amazon - Hacker Green | Dark (in progress)
info.description:
Amazon.com in the Hacker Green palette. The charcoal canvas carries
the original 40 px green grid and subtle 4 px scanlines. Terminal lettering,
translucent green panels, readable menus, green scrollbars, and edge glows
carry the look across navigation, search, filters, product details, cart,
and account views. Product photos retain their original colors.
